testimonials.text: I found the sections on early recognition of CNS excitation and the mechanism of Intralipid therapy particularly interesting. The real-world case examples helped tie everything together.
I liked the format of each slide being a question and the content of the slide being an answer.
The focus on early recognition of LAST signs was particularly valuable. Understanding subtle clinical indicators and how to differentiate them from other complications was extremely insightful.

What I found most interesting was how knowledgeable I became about LAST in such a short amount of time. I finished understanding the early warning signs, progression of toxicity, the risk factors and importance of rapid treatment with lipid emulsions.
I enjoyed learning about the use of Intralipid and the role (or lack of role) of Propofol in the management of LAST.
